strict_temporal_policy.actual_gpx: eligible after raw GPX continuity QC and road map-match quality checks
strict_temporal_policy.reconstructed_high: candidate class only; anchor map matching alone is insufficient and time-resolved route verification is required
strict_temporal_policy.reconstructed_partial: not globally eligible for Road x 10 min; only separately validated interval-censored subsegments may qualify
strict_temporal_policy.spatial_only: not eligible for Road x 10 min temporal negatives

important_note: The 21 high-reconstruction nights remain non-strict at whole-night level. Only separately verified reconstructed subsegments can enter strict Road x 10 min data.
